findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V140 renders shows the chest, side seams, waist, and hip/skirt junction still contain visibly faceted triangular patches, gaps, and overlapping surfaces. The torso-to-skirt transition is discontinuous.

The V140 mesh now shows more distinct long panel faces and narrow pleat relief than V139, but the front, rear, and profiles still read primarily as a broad conical flare. A sharp projecting shelf remains at the waist join; flat crest geometry alone does not resolve the sewn-panel silhouette.

Crouch and sit views remain irregular, with the skirt bunching against the thighs and exposing underlying shorts; rear panels and tabs protrude below the hem. The prone view remains a stiff fan of overlapping panels. Pose coverage and cloth response remain unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. Resolve torso/hip surface continuity and the waist shelf at the actual panel junction, and replace the remaining conical shell with an unambiguously panelized pleat construction. The current V140 flat-crest change improved face readability but did not pass appearance. Rebuild and inspect the full view and pose set. Fit, weights, UV, Unity, and VRChat remain independent unverified gates.
